serialId.description: Monotonic sequence identifier for this trade record.

orderId.description: Identifier of the order this trade was executed against.

clOrderId.description: Client-supplied order identifier of the originating order.

symbol.description: Trading pair, formatted as BASE-QUOTE (e.g. BTC-USDT).

base.description: Base currency of the trading pair.

quote.description: Quote currency of the trading pair.

orderType.description: Numeric order-type code of the originating order (limit, market, peg, TWAP).

triggerType.description: Numeric trigger order-type code (stop-loss, take-profit, stop-loss-limit, or take-profit-limit). Only meaningful when the originating order was a trigger order.

triggerPrice.description: Trigger price of the originating order. Only meaningful when the originating order was a trigger order.

size.description: Original order size of the originating order.

filledSize.description: Amount filled by this trade, in base currency.

feeCurrency.description: Currency in which the trading fee was charged.

feeAmount.description: Trading fee amount charged for this trade, in feeCurrency.

timestamp.description: Trade execution timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds.
